pages.text: Fire Aspect weapons hit as fire, snowballs as ice and the trident as water. Netherite armour gives a little fire resistance per piece.$(br2)Pickaxes hit iron, snow and copper golems for 1.5x.
pages.title: Elements

pages.text: Eating an enchanted golden apple gives a minute of use sickness, during which you can't eat another. Plain golden apples are untouched.
